passage.t: The philosophy of science is concerned with the history, origins, and methods of science. One
concern is what science is meant to achieve-and what it should be.

tasks.analysis: The philosophy of science is concerned with the history, origins, and methods of science. One question asked is what the true definition of science is. Another question concerns how reliable scientific theories can possibly be.
